title: A novel self-assembled Na{Cu                     <sub>12</sub>                     Zn                     <sub>4</sub>                     } multifunctional material: first report of a discrete coordination compound for detection of Ca                     <sup>2+</sup>                     ions and selective adsorption of cationic dyes in water
abstract: A novel discrete Na{Cu                     12                     Zn                     4                     } unit is discovered with the ability to sense calcium ions (with ultra-low detection limit) as well as to adsorb cationic dyes in the aqueous phase with high performance.
